task2_dieU.formula: mesh_mc18 dieU_bound = mc_worst_skew + routed_minus_sim_spread + gradient_worst_pair (nominal is INSIDE mc_worst, not added): TT 263.24 + 49.36 + 286.96 = 599.56; FF 242.94 + 36.19 + 237.64 = 516.77
task2_dieU.is_it_the_gate: NO. The gate (main die_sta_related.mesh_signoff) uses a PER-PAIR U(a,b) = max(max_s|ds|, |mu|+3sd) + |gap_a-gap_b| + |S_a-S_b|. dieU_bound stacks three die-wide extremes taken on different pairs (nominal 220 ps is between opposite die corners; gradient 287 between the two die ends) and is a summary only
task2_dieU.where_the_tail_is: pairs U > 120 ps (1,690 of 91,719) straddle the H-tree level-1/2 split lines (x ~15,970, y ~12,376): the two sides share only the root, so nominal (~130 ps) and gradient (~65 ps) are unshared there; the continuous mesh does not short them because both sides are driven hard by their own drivers
